This is consistent with the `perceptual_quality_auditor`'s note on 'waxy textures' or lack of grain, though the auditor didn't flag it as a distortion. I maintain this severity as it is a subtle but noticeable deviation from real-world weathered metal/plastic.
3. Structural Collapse: The Router noted warped background vehicles and merging poles (Severity 2.0). The `geometric_depth_auditor` did not explicitly flag fusion, but the visual evidence of indistinct boundaries in the background supports the Router's claim. I agree with this assessment.

I found no new catastrophic artifacts, but the cumulative effect of these minor-to-moderate issues prevents a perfect score.
